| **F$Mem** | Resize the data memory area | d0.l=desired size in bytes, rounded up to an allocation block ("16 bytes in version 2.0"); 0=information request | d0.l=actual size, (a1)=new end of the data area (+1) | Grows "contiguously upward", shrinks "downward from the old highest address": the base never moves (A6 points into it). Contracting to at or below the stack pointer is `E$DelSP` (223). An expansion may be refused with adequate memory free, because the space directly ABOVE the data area must itself be free (`Manual`, F$Mem page 1 - 43) - a C program built with `cc -I` loads `cio` right after entry and that module then sits above its data area, so `load` the trap handler first if a program'
